evidence.quote: The legend's 'per hour' annotation for kf is a typographical error. All three figures describe one physical rate: kf = 0.18 per minute = 10.8 per hour = 0.003 per second. kg = 0.12 per minute as printed. Use the per-minute values directly with the minute timetable; total rate kf + kg = 0.30 per minute.
